name: Automate
description: Automations for agents: reminders, schedules, webhooks and event triggers that create tasks, message a channel or start a flow. Same engine as the Automate window.

changelog.notes: Initial release — automations (schedule / once / webhook / event × create-task / channel-event / start-flow) over the backend automate.* API; absorbs the scheduler MCA (reminders, recurring tasks, snooze, bulk cancel, upcoming, time parsing).
